Container.Name: Recordhound

Branch.TagDescription: Built every night from the newest code: new features first, occasional bugs

Container.Overview:
Music recommendations built from your own Plex library and listening history. A list to browse, never automatic downloads.
Learns from Plex (Plexamp play counts and star ratings), ListenBrainz, Spotify, YouTube Music and Last.fm, then finds new artists through similar-artist data from ListenBrainz and Deezer (or Last.fm with a Pro key), with a clear reason for every pick. Shows what you're missing: artists you stream but don't own, Spotify liked songs that aren't in Plex, albums missing from artists you collect, and new releases from artists you love. Artist pages have previews (or full songs in your Spotify app), track lists and links to Spotify, Apple Music and Bandcamp. Rate the artists you play, one at a time, and the ratings go to Plex too. Send artists to Lidarr with your quality and metadata profiles.
Needs a Plex server with a music library. No API keys required. A short walkthrough on the first start sets everything up. Open source (AGPL-3.0).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: recommendations discovery music plex plexamp lastfm last.fm listenbrainz musicbrainz deezer spotify lidarr artists albums
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server with a music library. ListenBrainz, Spotify, Lidarr and Last.fm (needs Last.fm Pro from Dec 1, 2026) are optional.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. Changing it doesn't affect connecting Spotify.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly sync time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: HTTPS certificate
Config.Description: Optional. Serve HTTPS directly: path inside the container to a certificate, e.g. /data/certs/cert.pem (put it in your Data folder). Leave empty for plain HTTP or when a reverse proxy handles HTTPS. If you set this, change the WebUI link to https.

Config.Name: HTTPS key
Config.Description: Optional. The certificate's private key, e.g. /data/certs/key.pem.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses allowed to tell the app a request came in over HTTPS (your reverse proxy). Empty trusts private networks (192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16-31.x and Tailscale), which suits a proxy on your own server.
